page.overview:
Who is Angus Hetbury?

Angus Hetbury is an employee who works at the control room of Biosyn's research facility, alongside Denise Roberts and Sundar Kumar.

When the hyperloop pod that Ellie Sattler, Alan Grant and Maisie Lockwood are in is shut down near the Amber Mines, Ian asks Dodgson if there were dinosaurs in the mines. Angus recalls that dinosaurs are everywhere, even birds, "genetically speaking".
